resource: USE_INTENT payload with the map_item or map_object arm of field 4 (capabilities 4, 15 and 11)
allocation_impact: Capability 11 does not raise the USE_INTENT bound: the map_object placement is capped at 496 bytes so the largest intent (a u64::MAX tool handle, a 496-byte placement and a u64::MAX revision) is exactly 529 bytes, and the decoder refuses any larger payload before parsing.
boundary_tests: max=529: crates/protocol-oteryn/src/world_interaction_tests.rs use_with_map_object_arm_names_a_handleless_base_object_within_529_bytes (the largest intent decodes under capabilities 4, 15 and 11)
max+1=530: the same test refuses that intent plus one byte with LimitExceeded; a 497-byte placement is refused by the encoder
notes: WORLD-INTERACTION-0 §10.1 and §12; the owner decision of 2026-10-14 keeps 529 bytes unchanged. Same bound as ITEMUSE0-RL-03 and max_payload_bytes of command type 2. Registered by WORLDINT-WIRE-1.
